shortcut.selectleftchar.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-left is exercised on the react editor's only DOM text surface: the hf-caret pre enters footer editing (Insert ▸ Footer) with the caret at offset 1 of the 'Footer' text; Shift+ArrowLeft natively extends the selection one char left (offset 1->0)

shortcut.selectrightchar.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-right is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of 'Footer'); Shift+ArrowRight natively extends the selection one char right (offset 1->2)

shortcut.selectlineup.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-line-up is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of the single 'Footer' line); Shift+ArrowUp natively extends the selection to the line start (offset 1->0)

shortcut.selecttoendline.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-to-end-of-line is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of 'Footer'); Shift+End natively extends the selection to the line end (offset 1->6)

shortcut.selecttostartdocument.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-to-start-of-document is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of 'Footer'); Ctrl+Shift+Home natively extends the selection to the document start (offset 1->0)

shortcut.selecttoenddocument.note: WO022-4: the canvas body has no DOM selection — select-to-end-of-document is exercised on the footer tiptap surface (hf-caret pre, caret at offset 1 of 'Footer'); Ctrl+Shift+End natively extends the selection to the document end (offset 1->6)
